blocks.htmlEn:
Completely new upholstery in fine green genuine leather, harmonising with the two exterior colours.
Newly made, precisely fitted seat spring units.

blocks.html: Ein Traum eines Vorkriegs - Mercedes Typ 230, hier in der äußerst seltenen, langen, 4-türigen Cabrioletversion "D".
blocks.htmlEn: a dream pre-war Mercedes 230 in the exceptionally rare long, four-door Cabriolet D specification.

descriptionEn: Completely new upholstery in fine green genuine leather, harmonising with the two exterior colours. Newly made, precisely fitted seat spring units.
